46450-manual-of-the-trees-of-north-ameri.description: A book by Charles Sprague Sargent. Flowers usually monœcious; ovules 2 or several;  fruit a woody cone (_in Juniperus berry-like_); cotyledons 2  or many; leaves needle-shaped, linear or scale-like,  persistent (_deciduous in Larix and Taxodium_). Flowers diœcious, axillary, solitary; ovules 1;  fruit surrounded by or inclosed in the enlarged fleshy  aril-like disk of the flower; cotyledons 2; leaves linear,  alternate, persistent.

arxiv-1512-05607.title: On the Erdös similarity problem
arxiv-1512-05607.creator: Miroslav Chlebík
arxiv-1512-05607.description: Abstract . New partial results are obtained related to the following old problem of Erdös: for any infinite set X ⊆ ℝ X\subseteq\mathbb{R} to show that there is always a measurable (or, equivalently, closed) subset of ℝ \mathbb{R} of positive Lebesgue measure which contains no subset geometrically similar to X X .

arxiv-1909-03249.title: A curated Dataset of Microservices-Based Systems
arxiv-1909-03249.creator: Mohammad Imranur Rahman, Sebastiano Panichella, Davide Taibi
arxiv-1909-03249.description: Abstract Microservices based architectures are based on a set of modular, independent and fault-tolerant services. In recent years, the software engineering community presented studies investigating potential, recurrent, effective architectural patterns in microservices-based architectures, as they are very essential to maintain and scale microservice-based systems.

arxiv-2008-11676.title: Structural and optical properties of monocrystalline and polycrystalline gold plasmonic nanorods
arxiv-2008-11676.creator: Lukáš Kejík, Michal Horák, Tomáš Šikola, Vlastimil Křápek
arxiv-2008-11676.description: Abstract 1 CEITEC, Brno University of Technology, Purkyňova 123, 612 00 Brno, Czech Republic 2 Institute of Physical Engineering, Brno University of Technology, Technická 2, 616 69 Brno, Czech Republic ∗ These authors contributed equally. ∗ lukas.kejik(at)ceitec.vutbr.cz ∗ michal.horak2(at)ceitec.vutbr.cz Abstract Plasmonic structures are often fabricated by lithographic patterning of a thin metallic film.

arxiv-2111-07863.title: Gravity factorized
arxiv-2111-07863.description: Abstract We find models of two dimensional gravity that resolve the factorization puzzle and have a discrete spectrum, whilst retaining a semiclassical description. A novelty of these models is that they contain non-trivially correlated spacetime branes or, equivalently, nonlocal interactions in their action. Such nonlocal correlations are motivated in the low-energy gravity theory by integrating out UV degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2205-10276.title: A parafermionic hypergeometric function and supersymmetric 6 ​ j 6j -symbols
arxiv-2205-10276.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . We study properties of a parafermionic generalization of the hyperbolic hypergeometric function appearing as the most important part in the fusion matrix for Liouville field theory and the Racah-Wigner symbols for the Faddeev modular double. We show that this generalized hypergeometric function is a limiting form of the rarefied elliptic hypergeometric function V ( r ) V^{(r)} and derive its transformation properties and a mixed difference-recurrence equation satisfied by it.

arxiv-2303-10671.title: Breathing pyrochlore magnet CuGaCr 4 S 8 : Magnetic, thermodynamic, and dielectric properties
arxiv-2303-10671.creator: Masaki Gen, Hajime Ishikawa, Atsushi Miyake, Takeshi Yajima, Harald O. Jeschke, Hajime Sagayama, Akihiko Ikeda, Yasuhiro H. Matsuda, Koichi Kindo, Masashi Tokunaga, Yoshimitsu Kohama, Takashi Kurumaji, Yusuke Tokunaga, Taka-hisa Arima
arxiv-2303-10671.description: Abstract We investigate the crystallographic and magnetic properties of a chromium-based thiospinel CuGaCr 4 S 8 . From a synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiment and structural refinement, Cu and Ga atoms are found to occupy the tetrahedral A -sites in an alternate way, yielding breathing pyrochlore Cr network.

arxiv-2405-05320.title: Kinematic substructure in star clusters constrains star cluster formation
arxiv-2405-05320.creator: Becky Arnold, Nicholas J. Wright
arxiv-2405-05320.description: Abstract The spatial-kinematic structure of 48 young star clusters and associations is investigated. Moran’s I I statistic is used to quantify the degree of kinematic substructure in each region, and the results are compared to those expected assuming the hierarchical or monolithic models of star cluster formation.

arxiv-2408-00490.title: Graph Representation Learning via Causal Diffusion for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation
arxiv-2408-00490.creator: Chu Zhao, Enneng Yang, Yuliang Liang, Pengxiang Lan, Yuting Liu, Jianzhe Zhao, Guibing Guo, Xingwei Wang
arxiv-2408-00490.description: Abstract . Graph Neural Networks (GNNs)-based recommendation algorithms typically assume that training and testing data are drawn from independent and identically distributed (IID) spaces. However, this assumption often fails in the presence of out-of-distribution (OOD) data, resulting in significant performance degradation. In this study, we construct a Structural Causal Model (SCM) to analyze interaction data, revealing that environmental confounders (e.g.

arxiv-2502-07311.title: Differential inclusion systems with double phase competing operators, convection, and mixed boundary conditions
arxiv-2502-07311.creator: Jinxia Cen, Salvatore A. Marano, Shengda Zeng
arxiv-2502-07311.description: Abstract In this paper, a new framework for studying the existence of generalized or strongly generalized solutions to a wide class of inclusion systems involving double-phase, possibly competing differential operators, convection, and mixed boundary conditions is introduced. The technical approach exploits Galerkin’s method and a surjective theorem for multifunctions in finite dimensional spaces.

arxiv-2504-07054.title: Weighted Łojasiewicz inequalities and regularity of harmonic map flow
arxiv-2504-07054.creator: Alex Waldron
arxiv-2504-07054.description: Abstract . At a finite-time singularity of harmonic map flow in the critical dimension, we show that a Łojasiewicz inequality between the quantities appearing in Struwe’s monotonicity formula implies continuity of the body map and the no-neck property for bubble-tree decompositions. We prove such an inequality when the target is S 2 , S^{2}, yielding both properties in this case.

arxiv-2506-06532.title: Hierarchical and Collaborative LLM-Based Control for Multi-UAV Motion and Communication in Integrated Terrestrial and Non-Terrestrial Networks
arxiv-2506-06532.creator: Zijiang Yan, Hao Zhou, Jianhua Pei, Hina Tabassum
arxiv-2506-06532.description: Abstract Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have been widely adopted in various real-world applications. However, the control and optimization of multi-UAV systems remain a significant challenge, particularly in dynamic and constrained environments. This work explores the joint motion and communication control of multiple UAVs operating within integrated terrestrial and non-terrestrial networks that include high-altitude platform stations (HAPS).

arxiv-2508-09139.title: Quantum Sensing Radiative Decays of Neutrinos and Dark Matter Particles
arxiv-2508-09139.creator: Zhongtian Dong, Doojin Kim, Kyoungchul Kong, Myeonghun Park, Miguel A. Soto Alcaraz
arxiv-2508-09139.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhongtian Dong, Doojin Kim, Kyoungchul Kong, Myeonghun Park, Miguel A. Soto Alcaraz. We explore a novel strategy for detecting the radiative decay of very weakly interacting particles by leveraging the extreme sensitivity of quantum devices, such as superconducting transmon qubits and trapped ion systems, to faint electromagnetic signals. By modeling the effective electric field induced by the decay photons, we evaluate the response of quantum sensors across two particle physics scenarios: the cosmic neutrino background and two-component dark matter.

arxiv-2510-10589.title: RKKY interaction in Weyl semimetal nanowires
arxiv-2510-10589.creator: Rohit Mukherjee, Asutosh Dubey
arxiv-2510-10589.description: Abstract We investigate the effective couplings induced between localized impurities on the surface of a Weyl semimetal (WSM) nanowire within the framework of Ruderman–Kittel–Kasuya–Yosida (RKKY) theory. The itinerant electrons from the chiral Fermi arc surface states mediate impurity-impurity interaction at low energies. As a result, the spin–momentum locking naturally plays a central role in shaping the spin–spin correlations.

arxiv-2510-22016.title: Cost-Sensitive Evaluation for Binary Classifiers
arxiv-2510-22016.creator: Pierangelo Lombardo, Antonio Casoli, Cristian Cingolani, Shola Oshodi, Michele Zanatta
arxiv-2510-22016.description: Abstract Selecting an appropriate evaluation metric for classifiers is crucial for model comparison and parameter optimization, yet there is not consensus on a universally accepted metric that serves as a definitive standard. Moreover, there is often a misconception about the perceived need to mitigate imbalance in datasets used to train classification models.

arxiv-2511-17761.title: StealthCup: Realistic, Multi-Stage, Evasion-Focused CTF for Benchmarking IDS
arxiv-2511-17761.creator: Manuel Kern, Dominik Steffan, Felix Schuster, Florian Skopik, Max Landauer, David Allison, Simon Freudenthaler, Edgar Weippl
arxiv-2511-17761.description: Abstract . Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) are critical to defending enterprise and industrial control environments, yet evaluating their effectiveness under realistic conditions remains an open challenge. Existing benchmarks rely on synthetic datasets (e.g., NSL-KDD, CICIDS2017) or scripted replay frameworks, which fail to capture adaptive adversary behavior.

arxiv-2512-08982.title: Consist-Retinex: One-Step Noise-Emphasized Consistency Training Accelerates High-Quality Retinex Enhancement
arxiv-2512-08982.creator: Jian Xu, Wei Chen, Shigui Li, Delu Zeng, John Paisley, Qibin Zhao
arxiv-2512-08982.description: Abstract Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in low-light image enhancement through Retinex-based decomposition, yet their requirement for hundreds of iterative sampling steps severely limits practical deployment. While recent consistency models offer promising one-step generation for unconditional synthesis , their application to conditional enhancement remains unexplored. We present Consist-Retinex , the first framework adapting consistency modeling to Retinex-based low-light enhancement.

pmc-12579226.title: ClairS-TO: a deep-learning method for long-read tumor-only somatic small variant calling
pmc-12579226.creator: Lei Chen, Zhenxian Zheng, Junhao Su, Xian Yu, Angel On Ki Wong, Jingcheng Zhang, Yan-Lam Lee, Ruibang Luo
pmc-12579226.description: Accurate detection of somatic variants in tumors is of critical importance and remains challenging. Current methods typically require matched normal samples for reliable detection, which are often unavailable in real-world research and clinical scenarios. Without a matched normal sample, more proficient algorithms are required to distinguish true somatic variants from germline variants and technical artifacts.

pmc-13079651.title: The relationship between green space and myopia in children and adolescents: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13079651.creator: Junjie Wang, Gang Sun, Cuimei Shen, Houwei Zhu, Zhanyang He
pmc-13079651.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effect of green space exposure on the risk of myopia in children and adolescents.MethodsStudies on the relationship between green space and myopia in children and adolescents published before October 1, 2024, were retrieved from five electronic databases: web of Science Core Collection, PubMed, EBSCOhost, ScienceDirect and Cochrane Library.

pmc-13415370.title: Distribution and function of human long-lasting T cells in aging and non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-13415370.creator: Jia Xuan Tan, Hua Run Yu, Yong Gu, Hai Hong
pmc-13415370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). T lymphocytes, essential components of the adaptive immune system, orchestrate pathogen-specific responses and long-term immunological memory through heterogeneous subsets with distinct functional properties and spatial distributions. This comprehensive review delineates the origin, distribution, and functional specialization of long-lasting T cell subsets—naive T cells (Tn), stem cell-like memory T cells (Tscm), central memory T cells (Tcm), effector memory T cells (Tem), and tissue-resident memory T cells (Trm)—across physiological and pathological contexts, with a particular focus on aging and non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).

pmc-13613811.title: Zinc oxide nanoparticles against Candida: mechanistic pathways, synergistic potentials, and biocompatibility challenges in the era of antimicrobial resistance
pmc-13613811.creator: Binaya Krushna Sahu, Tapan Kumar Mohanta, Mahesh Chandra Sahu, Sujogya Kumar Panda
pmc-13613811.description: The emergence of antifungal resistance among diverse Candida species highlights the need for a more efficient and effective approach to address this issue. Nanotechnology has emerged as a transformative approach with great promise to counter antifungal resistance, a global concern that has surged over the past two decades.
